tabs.content:
// ── Tables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.create-merge table sensor_telemetry (
    sensor_id: string, equipment_sk: long, facility_sk: long,
    reading_ts: datetime, ch4_ppm: real, baseline_ppm: real,
    exceedance_flag: bool, wind_speed_ms: real, wind_dir_deg: real,
    sensor_status: string, ingest_ts: datetime
)

.create-merge table plume_detection_hot (
    plume_id: string, detect_ts: datetime,
    source_lat: real, source_lon: real,
    emission_rate_kg_s: real, emission_rate_confidence: real,
    wind_speed_ms: real, wind_dir_deg: real, is_synthetic: bool,
    anchor_distance_km: real
)

.create-merge table workorder_event (
    ticket_id: string, facility_sk: long, equipment_sk: long,
    event_ts: datetime, from_status: string, to_status: string,
    actor: string, note: string
)

.create-merge table facility_kpi_snapshot_6h (
    snapshot_ts: datetime, facility_sk: long,
    active_plumes: int, open_tickets: int,
    compliance_violations: int, risk_score: real,
    monthly_financial_impact: real, mean_time_to_repair_hr: real,
    equipment_health_score: real, emission_rate_kg_s_sum: real
)

.alter tables (sensor_telemetry, plume_detection_hot, workorder_event)
    policy caching hot = 90d

.alter table facility_kpi_snapshot_6h policy caching hot = 365d

.alter table sensor_telemetry policy retention '{"SoftDeletePeriod": "1825.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

.alter table plume_detection_hot policy retention '{"SoftDeletePeriod": "1825.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

.create-or-alter materialized-view with (backfill=true)
    facility_kpi_mv on table sensor_telemetry
{
    sensor_telemetry
    | summarize
        reading_count = count(),
        avg_ch4       = avg(ch4_ppm),
        exceedances   = countif(exceedance_flag == true)
      by facility_sk, bin(reading_ts, 6h)
}
